question: The volume of a right circular cylinder is 8624 cm³. If the radius and height of the cylinder are equal, then find the height of the cylinder. (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the radius and height of a cylinder are equal (r = h), the volume simplifies to πh³.

⇒ πh³ = 8624

⇒ (22/7) × h³ = 8624

⇒ h³ = 8624 × 7 ÷ 22 = 2744

⇒ h = ³√2744 = 14 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 14 cm.**
